description: This file defines the API endpoints for managing 'likes' on social share posts in the OrangeHRM Buzz module. It includes methods for listing likes, liking a post, and unliking a post, with validation and transaction management.

classes.name: BuzzLikeOnShareAPI
classes.description: API class providing endpoints for listing, creating, and deleting likes on shared posts in the Buzz module.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of likes on a specific share post, with sorting and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Adds a like to a specific share post, ensuring no duplicate like exists.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes a like from a share post if it exists.

methods.name: setBuzzLikeOnShare
methods.description: Helper to set properties of a BuzzLikeOnShare object before saving.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Defines validation rules for 'getAll' method parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Defines validation rules for 'create' method parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Defines validation rules for 'delete' method parameters.
